semiconductor_relevance: High — Aode specializes in temperature control equipment specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Suzhou AODE Precise Equipment Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of temperature control equipment that serves the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include chillers and temperature control devices tailored for various semiconductor applications, ensuring precise thermal management during manufacturing.

regional_presence.China: Aode has eight major production bases in East and South China and sales and service centers in multiple cities.
